description:
There is a mass lesion located in the left cerebellopontine angle, extending into the internal acoustic meatus.

The lesion is hypointense on T1-weighted imaging and demonstrates heterogeneous T2 hyperintensity. Multiple cystic components are present, possibly representing central necrosis. There are also areas of signal dropout on SWI.

The lesion shows marked but somewhat heterogeneous contrast enhancement, which may reflect neoangiogenesis.
